prompt: In which year did California experience its second instance of wildfires burning more than 2 million acres, destroying scores of homes and other buildings?
answer: California’s second year with wildfires burning more than 2 million acres was **2020**. Fires that year ultimately burned over 4 million acres and destroyed or damaged thousands of homes and other structures.
